scope: Read-only original PNG alpha, current Unity-exported rects/PPU and appearance pairs. All qualifying pixels included, including disconnected weapons. No component exclusions. Authored subset obtained from CharacterData Sprites and Poses GUID/localID refs.

method.thresholdPolicy: All alpha>128 pixels within each exact frame, matching the existing QualityMotionAtlasTools native strong-alpha policy. Includes all disconnected opaque pieces and weapons; no largest-component filtering.
method.height: (max qualified Y - min qualified Y + 1) / actual Unity pixelsPerUnit
method.comparison: equipped visible world height / original visible world height
method.authoredCoverage: CharacterData Sprites/Poses GUID/localID refs matched to current EquipmentAppearance pairs. All mappings also checked, including 84 mappings not in the existing authored test subset.

syntheticEvidence: Alpha128 support padding does not enlarge the measured height.
A disconnected alpha129 pixel expands total visible bounds.
A frame without alpha>128 pixels fails.
A true 2x opaque body at identical PPU fails the unchanged range.
testChange.unityCompilationAndExecution: Pending root execution; this document is PNG analysis, not an engine test result.

limitations: Total visible height includes hair, clothing and weapons; it is not an anatomical body measurement.
A passing scale contract does not prove smooth pose transitions, accurate hands or lack of clipping. Actual prior static/continuous visual reviews remain separate evidence.
This report does not claim that weak pixels are deleted or invisible under every compositing condition. They remain preserved in production pixels and are excluded only from this size metric.
